title: The normalized square cancels the target section unit
statement: Let f:X→S, k:Z→T, g:T→S, v:Z→X and h:vf=kg be a commuting square [lem-weil-pbc-derived-square-unit-map]. Let G be a module sheaf on Z, J an injective resolution, q a natural number and V an open of S. Put U=f inverse V, and t=unitQ_v(J.cochainComplex) followed by Rv_*(Q(J.ι′) inverse). Start with the raw cohomology of sections of v_*J on U. The natural section unit for f [def-weil-pbc-direct-image-section-unit], followed by local hypercohomology of Rf_*(t) and the right-adjoint derived square comparison, then topEdgeLocalLeray_g, squareInverseOpenComparison_g and b_k inverse [def-weil-pbc-square-resolution-roof-models, def-weil-pbc-derived-square-local-models], is the identity. The target b_k uses the equality v inverse U=k inverse(g inverse V). There is no source coefficient sheaf, coefficient map, auxiliary complex L, numerator beta or denominator ell.

theorem squareSectionUnit_cancellation {X S Z T : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (k : Z ⟶ T) (g : T ⟶ S) (v : Z ⟶ X) (h : v ≫ f = k ≫ g)
    (G : Z.Modules) (J : InjectiveResolution G) (q : ℕ) (V : S.Opens) :
    let U := f ⁻¹ᵁ V
    let t := (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage v.toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerivedFunctorUnitQ
       J.cochainComplex ≫
        (schemeDerivedDirectImage v).map (inv (DerivedCategory.Q.map J.ι'))
    directImageSectionUnitAt f (q : ℤ) V
        (((pushforward v).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj J.cochainComplex) ≫
      ((RingedSpace.localHypercohomologyPresheaf S.toRingedSpace (q : ℤ)).map
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).map t ≫
          (derivedSquareRightComparison f k g v h).hom.app
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
              (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj G))).app (op V) ≫
      (RingedSpace.topEdgeLocalLeray g.toLRSHom.toShHom (q : ℤ)
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage k).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj G))).hom.app (op V) ≫
      (squareInverseOpenComparison g (q : ℤ)
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage k).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj G))).hom.app (op V) ≫
      (squareInjectiveLocalComparison k G q (g ⁻¹ᵁ V) J (v ⁻¹ᵁ U) (by
        rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, h])).inv = 𝟙 _
